description: This Java source file defines the ProtocolFactory class, which provides static helper methods for creating and manipulating protocol-related objects such as AdaptableBuilder, TopicPath, Payload, Headers, and JsonifiableAdaptable within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ProtocolFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static helper methods for creating and manipulating protocol-related objects in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: newAdaptableBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new AdaptableBuilder for a given TopicPath or existing Adaptable.

methods.name: setExtra
methods.description: Creates a new Adaptable with additional 'extra' fields in its payload.

methods.name: newTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs a TopicPath from a string path, parsing its components.

methods.name: newTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a TopicPathBuilder for various ID types (ThingId, NamespacedEntityId, PolicyId).

methods.name: newPayload
methods.description: Creates Payload objects from JSON string or JsonObject.

methods.name: newPayloadBuilder
methods.description: Creates a PayloadBuilder, optionally with a JSON path.

methods.name: newHeadersWithDittoContentType
methods.description: Creates Headers with Ditto protocol content type.

methods.name: newHeaders
methods.description: Creates Headers from a collection of header entries or a JsonObject.

methods.name: wrapAsJsonifiableAdaptable
methods.description: Wraps an Adaptable into a JsonifiableAdaptable for JSON representation.

methods.name: jsonifiableAdaptableFromJson
methods.description: Creates a JsonifiableAdaptable from a JsonObject.
